title: Amount of the Appointment Series Late-Cancellation Fee
content:
Patient financial policy — amount clause.

**Clause.** The late-cancellation fee on an Appointment Series is the late-cancellation basis, and the late-cancellation basis is the late-cancellation fee of the series' visit format. The fee is carried in full through its calculation and rounded to the nearest cent once, on the final amount, never at an intermediate step.

**What is read.** The visit format of the series, from the series record, and that format's late-cancellation fee.

**Worked example (hypothetical figure).** For a format whose late-cancellation fee is USD 45.00, the late-cancellation basis is USD 45.00 and the fee charged is USD 45.00.
